items.original: He said, "I am reading a book now."
a: He said that he was reading a book then.

items.original: The teacher said to us, "Work hard."
a: The teacher advised us to work hard.
The teacher told us to work hard.

items.original: She said, "What a beautiful bird it is!"
a: She exclaimed with wonder that it was a very beautiful bird.
items.rule_bn: Exclamatory: exclaimed with wonder that; what a→a very।
